cursor.description: Cursor from next_cursor. Resumes after the last entry of the previous page, so an entry that exists for the whole read comes back exactly once. A key written between pages can be missing. Keep filters unchanged between pages. Takes precedence over offset.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this canvas.

key_prefix.description: Only read entries whose key starts with this prefix.

offset.description: Entry offset from next_offset. Keep filters unchanged between pages. Prefer cursor: an offset can skip or repeat entries when state changes between pages.

scope.description:
Only read this scope.

* `user` - user
* `shared` - shared
